In this instalment of Stable Tours, TTR catches up with Gavin Bedggood who is hoping to put G1 Zabeel Classic victor Kingswood on a Caulfield Cup pathway. The boutique stable has plenty of proven horses with strong spring targets and a handful of exciting juveniles to unveil this season.

Diamond Necklace's unbeaten streak came to an end at Deauville on Sunday when downed by Aventure in the G1 Prix Jean et Louis Romanet, while Senorita Bonita draws comparisons to Alcohol Free with her G1 Prix Morny victory. Plus, the Australian Bloodstock-owned Defiantly earns a spot in the 2026 G1 Melbourne Cup field with a bold victory in the G2 Prix Kergorlay.

Olly Tait says racing gives people the thrill of being professional athletes but we need to do more to capitalise on this. The Hunter Valley stallion parades concluded on Sunday after four days of viewing some of the country's finest horseflesh, all within roughly an hour's drive of one another. Visitors to Vinery Stud, Arrowfield Stud, Widden Stud, and Coolmore Stud highlighted who they most loved seeing this weekend.

In this instalment of Stable Tours, TTR catches up with Lucy Yeomans as Changing Colours is the star of her young team. With the stable having a focus on providing affordable opportunities, a patient development approach and the aim of placing horses to win, Yeomans is building an exciting future.

A clash of titans happened in the opening Group 1 of the racing season, and it was star mare Autumn Glow who emerged victorious in the G1 Winx Stakes, handing Chris Waller a 10th win in the race. Midnight In Tokyo upgraded herself yet again when dominating the G3 Show County Quality, and Cavalry Girl books a G1 Moir Stakes tilt after winning the G3 Carlyon Stakes at Sandown.
